copy_fallback_policy.decision_6: STRICTLY FORBIDDEN. Junction first, symlink fallback; if both fail -> exit 6 with clear error.
copy_fallback_policy.ps1_start: No copy fallback (already junction -> symlink -> exit 5). Needs update to exit 6.
copy_fallback_policy.sh_start: Symlink only (ln -s). Needs update to trap errors and exit 6.

rollback_behavior.decision_6: Rollback ONLY paths created by installer; do not destroy foreign directory trees.
rollback_behavior.ps1_start: Executed 'Remove-Item -LiteralPath $DestDir -Recurse -Force', which wiped the whole destination directory on verification failure.
rollback_behavior.sh_start: Executed 'rm -rf $DEST_DIR', wiping whole directory on verification failure.
